integrity: The dual general-position classification is proved for every n>=4 by the general-position independence lemma and geodesic-convexity obstructions for each possible selected pair. Shortest-path exhaustive checks for n=4..7 are corroborative only. The previously published strong-resolving-graph edge classification is explicitly credited as prior coverage of the outer variant.
scientific_limitations: The surviving novel claim is the exact dual-general-position optimum and unique maximizing pair for half graphs n>=4; the known total and outer variants are background only.
The n=3 boundary has an additional dual optimum and is excluded.

The Resultary 2026-10-04 strong metric chain-graph theorem explicitly determines all mutually maximally distant pairs and thus, with the Tian--Klavzar characterization, already implies the half-graph outer maximum-pair classification.
An earlier non-indexed classification of dual general position on half or chain graphs remains a residual priority risk.
title: Unique maximum dual general-position set in half graphs
